Brand Intervention Governance v0.2 validation

Validated against Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version from the user-supplied debug package.

Compatibility baseline:
- Alchemy Objects v0.8
- ooRexx Crypto v0.1
- Brand Interaction Effect v0.6
- Brand Journey v0.1
- Brand Journey Population v0.2
- Brand Intervention v0.2
- Brand Intervention Effectiveness v0.2
- Institutional Policy v0.6
- Runtime Registry v0.14

Direct package suite: PASS.
Compile sweep: 24/24 .rex/.cls targets PASS.
Runtime Registry stage/activate/acquire/release: PASS.
Alchemy sealed-introspection/privacy regression: PASS.

v0.2 policy-boundary regressions:
- recommend(binding) without explicit rules fails GOVERNANCE_RULE_SET_REQUIRED: PASS
- authority-backed Institutional Policy release resolves exact governance rule-set payload: PASS
- policy id/version/semantic identity and publication authority evidence survive into reasoning material: PASS
- not-yet-effective Institutional Policy release cannot be selected early: PASS
- explicit low-level rule recommendation is marked institutionally unmanaged: PASS
- positive exposure decision from unmanaged rules is rejected: PASS
- non-expanding NO_CHANGE record remains permitted: PASS
- managed positive decision with named domain authority remains non-executing: PASS

Preserved v0.1 guarantees:
- promising evidence remains controlled review rather than executable action
- guardrail outcomes are not collapsed into one scalar utility score
- mixed primary/guardrail evidence forces withdrawal/regression review
- positive primary evidence without required guardrails cannot progress
- stale evidence cannot change treatment exposure
- current-window regression is preserved separately from prior/long-baseline evidence
- randomized provenance does not self-promote causal authority
- authority scope is enforced
- divergent decisions require opaque evidence references
- free prose/customer data is rejected from decision/evidence reference channels
- recorded governance decisions still require an external execution component
- Service-as-Sales / promotional context does not imply sales authority

Institutional Policy remains the owner of publication, authority, lifecycle, deployment topology, progressive rollout and exact operative version selection. Brand Intervention Governance consumes and preserves those results; it does not duplicate them.
